title: Home Assistant
summary: Control your Home Assistant from the deck: tiles for favourites and rooms.
description: A client of your own Home Assistant server on the local network. Sign in by scanning a QR code with a phone. Tiles with Home Assistant's icons and state colours: Favourites, a tab per area, All. Tap an icon to switch a light, run a scene, set a brightness; locks and garage doors ask first. Live states, greyed when offline. Not affiliated with the Home Assistant project. Needs Home Assistant on your network and a phone.
